hot_core_bias_test.hypothesis: hot tools' 3.5k-char descriptions out-compete one-line summaries regardless of fit
hot_core_bias_test.result: REFUTED. Removing the hot core saved ~1,115 tokens (11,566 -> 10,451) and made selection WORSE: science_search 3/3 -> 2/3, weather_history scattered across three answers, and only the court-records case improved. Keeping web_search + web_fetch fully loaded is justified on accuracy, not just on the owner's preference.

fixture_bugs_found: #3/#4 asked the model to plot data it did not have — a gather step first was correct.
#9 said 'here', making a current_location read a legitimate first step.
Pattern: when a probe contains a deictic ('here', 'my', 'that'), the resolving tool is a valid answer and must be in `expect`. Three of sixteen cases had this bug on first writing.
